sloka: एवमुक्ता तु कैकेयी कोपेन ज्वलितानना ।दीर्घमुष्टम् विनिःश्वस्य मन्थरामिदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-९-१॥
transliteration: evamuktā tu kaikeyī kopena jvalitānanā ।dīrghamuṣṭam viniḥśvasya mantharāmidam abravīt ॥2-9-1॥

translations.english: Thus spoken to, Kaikeyi, her face burning with anger, breathed a deep, hot sigh and said these words to Manthara:
